# A trained readout on random-walk distributions (generated by experiments/score_trained_diffusion_readout.py)

451 perturbations, 5 disease-cluster folds (seed 0). Features: the walk distribution over reaction and metabolite nodes, square-rooted, reduced to 32 components by a truncated SVD fitted on each fold's training genes, standardised. Readout: per-symptom L2 logistic regression, strength chosen from [0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 10.0] by 3-fold inner cross-validation on average precision; symptoms with fewer than 5 training positives get the training base rate. Differences are against the untrained walk (B1) and are read three ways as in docs/twin_comparisons.md: per fold (t interval, 4 df), pooled (paired bootstrap over perturbations, 1000 resamples) and pooled within fold-by-degree strata; 95 percent intervals, not corrected.
